newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs to test downside,eyes on output data.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs to test downside,eyes on output data.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK FOR BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: INJECTION OF 100 BLN YEN
*Key June 10-year JGB futures expected to test downside on Thursday, retaining weakness from LIFFE overnight.

*Market watching industrial output data for April and forecasts for May and June, due at 0430 GMT. Focus on forecast for output in June, expected at around minus one. If forecast comes in stronger, JGBs likely to be sold.
